Operating revenues decreased by $449.1 million, or 8.4%, to $4,913.4 million in 2024 compared to 2023, primarily due to a decrease in average yield of 5.1% and decrease in traffic of 3.5%, year over year.
TRASM for 2024 was 9.27 cents, a decrease of 3.7% compared to 2023. This decrease was primarily a result of a 5.1% decrease in average yield, year over year.
Total revenue per passenger flight segment decreased 8.5% from $121.58 in 2023 to $111.21 in 2024. The decrease in total revenue per passenger flight segment was primarily due to a decrease of 5.1% in average yield, year over year.

Spirit Airlines reported these 16 operating statistics for the year ended 31 December 2024, in the "Comparative Operating Statistics" table of its FY2024 10-K. The company labels them unaudited.

| # | KPI | FY 2024 Total |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Average aircraft | 209.9 |
| 2 | Aircraft at end of period* | 213 |
| 3 | Average daily aircraft utilization (hours) | 9.9 |
| 4 | Departures | 288,180 |
| 5 | Passenger flight segments (PFSs) (thousands) | 44,180 |
| 6 | Revenue passenger miles (RPMs) (thousands) | 43,671,009 |
| 7 | Available seat miles (ASMs) (thousands) | 53,017,948 |
| 8 | Load factor | 82.4% |
| 9 | Total revenue per passenger flight segment | $111.21 |
| 10 | Average yield (cents) | 11.25 |
| 11 | TRASM, total revenue per ASM (cents) | 9.27 |
| 12 | CASM, cost per ASM (cents) | 11.35 |
| 13 | Adjusted CASM (cents) | 10.76 |
| 14 | Adjusted CASM ex-fuel (cents) | 7.97 |
| 15 | Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) | 551,819 |
| 16 | Average fuel cost per gallon | $2.68 |

*The 213 aircraft include 21 that were classified as assets held for sale at 31 December 2024.

Adjusted CASM and Adjusted CASM ex-fuel are not GAAP measures. For example, Adjusted CASM leaves out special charges, which were $36.0 million in 2024.

**Sources**
- Spirit Airlines, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2024, filed 2025-03-03, accession no. 0001498710-25-000008 (CIK 1498710). The figures come from Item 7, MD&A, "Comparative Operating Statistics."
